assessment.what_changed_en: Changed the end of Risto Ryti's presidential term in the summary box and resignation section from 1 August 1944 (when he submitted his resignation so Finland could disavow his personal letter to Ribbentrop) to 4 August 1944 (when Parliament swore in Mannerheim).
assessment.uncertainty_note: Both dates reflect real constitutional milestones in August 1944: Ryti resigned on 1 August (Prime Minister Linkomies acted as head of state in the interim), and Mannerheim took office by special law on 4 August.
assessment.historical_note_en: Ryti's resignation on 1 August 1944 enabled Finland to argue that the June 1944 Ryti–Ribbentrop commitment not to seek a separate peace bound Ryti personally rather than his successor Mannerheim.

incidents.confidence_note: Three distinct editor identities repeating the same date change across 682 days meet the Level 3 criteria.
